text.p: The average yield at the latest auction of three-month discount treasury bills rose to 49.37 percent from 42.25 percent at the last sale on November 12, a central bank statement said on Friday.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared with the last issue of three-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 79,000 UAH 2.01 million UAH
The central bank sold 8,913 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of six-month discount treasury bills rose to 50.33 percent from 49.01 percent at the last sale on November 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of six-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Amount sold 5.78 million UAH 4.18 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.62 million UAH 3.36 million UAH
The central bank sold 57,780 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 15.
The average yield at the latest auction of nine-month discount treasury bills rose to 58.20 from 58.18 percent at the last sale on November 12, a central bank statement said.
The results of Thursday's auction, compared to the last issue of nine-month discount T-bills, were as follows:
Actual amount raised 90,000 UAH 1.23 million UAH
The central bank sold 1,332 T-bills, the bank's statement said.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for November 15.
The auction of 12-month discount treasury bills scheduled for November 14 was cancelled without explanation, a central bank statement said.
